# REMAINING_WORK — Better Render + AI + Release Mission

> The Awtsmoos renews every unfinished edge until measurement, Git, and production tell one story still;  
> Awtsmoos.com lets each vessel become richer, faster, safer, and deployed according to the tested will.

## Planning

- [x] Phase One boundless improvement brainstorm written.
- [x] Phase Two architecture critique with 20+ corrections written.
- [x] Phase Three final execution plan with 30+ additional refinements written.
- [x] Release/improvement evidence written from measured results.

## Render Performance

- [x] Fresh-read the cinematic renderer and pixel primitives.
- [x] Establish representative baseline latency and frame hashes.
- [x] Identify per-pixel color parsing / recursive primitive overhead as the dominant bottleneck.
- [x] Fully rewrite `PixelCanvas.js` with cached RGB decoding and direct bounded writes.
- [x] Prove seven representative cinematic frame hashes remain byte-identical.
- [x] Measure about 10.45x representative mean-frame speedup.
- [x] Measure a sustained 120-frame 12 FPS sample at about 141.94 ms/frame.
- [x] Reject child-process frame farming for this pass because primitive optimization removed the practical bottleneck.
- [x] Render the complete 180-second movie at the original 12 FPS / 2,160 true frames.
- [x] Preserve regression tests and a reusable render benchmark.

## AI Richness

- [x] Fresh-read prompt/compiler/scene composition seams without overwriting the concurrently dirty compiler lane.
- [x] Capture five-prompt baseline showing the old forced ten-layer recipe.
- [x] Fix the `motion graphic` / `graph` false feature inference.
- [x] Add deterministic feature policy below the Director.
- [x] Add purpose-driven camera grammar.
- [x] Add semantic layer composition for 2D, infographic, tutorial, 3D, particles, characters, and hybrid intent.
- [x] Add scene-purpose/narrative vocabulary.
- [x] Verify requested feature coverage and 2D-only restraint.
- [x] Pass the focused semantic-richness suite 5/5.

## Repository / Release Hardening

- [x] Detect and reject a false merge resolution that still contained raw conflict markers.
- [x] Repair the poisoned merge overlap without force-pushing.
- [x] Restore MitzvahWorld production/source contracts and pass 9/9 focused tests.
- [x] Restore required homepage direct routes and pass `verifyHomeSource.mjs`.
- [x] Replace stale comments white-box policy testing with a modular runtime contract.
- [x] Pass comments tests 18/18.
- [x] Pass root `npm test` with exit code 0 across the repository-wide release chain.
- [x] Establish that `scripts/bhRelease.mjs`, not the invalid GitHub workflow placeholder, is the guarded production authority.
- [ ] Collect every current staged, unstaged, and untracked workspace change into one exact publish snapshot.
- [ ] Run focused validation for Studio federation/backend/export and Apps-filter changes that landed after the root suite began.
- [ ] Re-run exact-snapshot conflict, diff-integrity, secret-pattern, secret-path, and repository-hygiene gates.
- [ ] Commit the complete workspace snapshot on `main`.
- [ ] Fetch and non-destructively integrate any remote movement after commit if necessary.
- [ ] Push `main` without force.
- [ ] Prove remote `main` SHA equals local release SHA.
- [ ] Run the guarded production activation for that exact pushed SHA.
- [ ] Independently verify production homepage and critical Studio/public routes.

## Studio / Product Improvement Frontier

- [ ] Inspect and converge the newly landed Studio federation/backend/export/spatial renderer stack after release.
- [ ] Add compact semantic-richness and target-fidelity feedback to Studio.
- [ ] Add render-quality/profile disclosure without mutating canonical movie content.
- [ ] Verify Studio real-3D capability claims against actual renderer behavior.
- [ ] Browser-test desktop and mobile interactions, overflow, accessibility, AI generation, seek, playback, and export flows.
- [ ] Search again for duplicated movie schemas/renderers/generators that can move into shared libraries or procedural core.

## Verification / Handoff

- [x] Bank focused Studio 5/5 and shared-movie 27/27 suites from the prior stable snapshot.
- [x] Bank PixelCanvas and AI semantic regression evidence.
- [x] Bank root repository-wide test exit 0 after the comments policy repair.
- [ ] Re-run focused tests against the final concurrent publish tail.
- [ ] Read back the final release evidence and all source touched by this pass.
- [ ] Record exact commit SHA, remote SHA, deployment receipt, and production verification.
- [ ] Search for hidden technical debt / unfinished work after deployment.

## NEXT_ACTION

Collect the complete current workspace into an exact staged snapshot, run focused tests for the newly landed Studio/Apps tail plus final publish safety gates, then commit, push, activate the exact SHA, and verify production before returning to deeper Studio improvements.
